WARNING

This game may cause motion sickness, dizziness or nausea.

It contains bright, flashing and strobing lights. A small number of people may have seizures when they see them, even with no history of epilepsy. If you, or anyone in your family, have had seizures or epilepsy, talk to a doctor before playing.

Stop playing at once and rest if you feel dizzy or sick, or notice altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, disorientation, or any movement you can’t control. Play in a well-lit room, keep the screen at a comfortable distance, and take a break at least once an hour.

Some sounds are sudden and loud: the volumes are in Options.

Options › Accessibility can calm the camera and the menus, and lower LUMINANCE to dim every glow and flash.
